editorial_thesis: In 2026-W37 efficiency went vertical at the platform layer: OpenAI expanded its Sep 10 stack with Financial Services on Astra, a separate GPT-Live-1 voice API, and an Agents API harness; DeepSeek's Sep 10 V4.1-Flash vendor-reported results place its efficiency ahead of its Pro tier at Flash pricing while the announced Sep 14 routing remains a future operation; Cognition pushed coding efficiency (SWE-2) and harness efficiency (Fusion, verified ordinary at 17:00Z); and open weights went vertical (MiniCPM on-device, North translation, Ling multimodal) — with Anthropic's Sep 10 threat report setting the week's technical safety bound.
architecture_goals: Present Financial Services on Astra without absorbing the separate voice/harness surfaces
Present the voice API as a delegating layer with beta/preview discipline
Ground the efficient release in vendor-attributed comparison with future routing kept future-tense
Show coding/harness efficiency with partnered-eval bounds
Show open vertical releases with license/date precision
Let the threat report carry the technical safety package with notable-examples bounds
